title: Change another user's password via user_id in body
desc: POST /api/users/change_password accepted a numeric user_id in the body with no ownership check.
steps:
1. Capture change-password request
2. Replace user_id with victim's ID
3. Submit — password changed

title: Access private files via sequential integer IDs
desc: File download endpoint used sequential IDs. Iterating exposed other users' private files.
steps:
1. Upload file, note returned ID
2. Iterate: GET /api/files/{id-1}/download
3. Download other users' files

title: Delete any account via exposed admin endpoint
desc: Admin-style endpoint /api/admin/users/{id}/delete lacked role checks. Any authenticated user could delete arbitrary accounts.
steps:
1. Find endpoint via JS source
2. Send DELETE /api/admin/users/{victim_id}/delete
3. Account deleted

title: View private messages of any user
desc: Messaging API endpoint /api/messages?thread_id= did not verify thread ownership. Any authenticated user could read private threads.
steps:
1. Open your own thread, note thread_id
2. Enumerate thread_id values
3. Read other users' private messages

title: Access any driver's earnings report
desc: Earnings endpoint /api/driver/{id}/earnings used driver ID from URL with no ownership check.
steps:
1. Log in as driver, note your driver_id
2. Replace with another driver's ID
3. View their earnings data

title: Read private repository contents via project ID
desc: API endpoint /api/v4/projects/{id}/repository/files accepted any project ID without checking visibility settings.
steps:
1. Find a private project ID via enumeration
2. GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/repository/files/README.md?ref=main
3. Read private source code

title: View any booking details via reservation ID
desc: Reservation detail endpoint used a guessable alphanumeric ID. No ownership check allowed viewing other guests' booking info.
steps:
1. Make a booking, note reservation ID format
2. Enumerate similar IDs
3. View other guests' personal and payment info

title: Download any user's tax form via IDOR
desc: Tax document download endpoint /api/tax/{user_id}/download lacked authorization. Any researcher could download another's tax documents.
steps:
1. Request your own tax form, capture request
2. Replace user_id with another researcher's ID
3. Download their tax document

title: Modify any store's products via merchant ID swap
desc: Product update API accepted merchant_id in the request body. Replacing it with another merchant's ID allowed modifying their product listings.
steps:
1. Capture product update request
2. Replace merchant_id with target store's ID
3. Modify or delete their products

title: View private activity routes via activity ID
desc: Activity endpoint returned full GPS route data for private activities when queried directly by ID.
steps:
1. Find a user's activity ID from their public profile
2. GET /api/activities/{id} — returns full GPS data
3. View private route even if set to private

title: Read messages in private channels via channel ID
desc: Message history API /api/conversations.history accepted any channel ID. Private channel messages readable by non-members.
steps:
1. Enumerate channel IDs (format: C0XXXXXXX)
2. Call conversations.history with private channel ID
3. Read private messages

title: Access any ticket via ticket ID enumeration
desc: Support ticket endpoint /api/tickets/{id} returned full ticket content including customer PII without checking if requester owned the ticket.
steps:
1. Create a ticket, note your ticket ID
2. Enumerate nearby IDs
3. Read other customers' support tickets

title: Transfer funds from any account via account ID
desc: Internal transfer endpoint accepted source account_id in POST body without verifying ownership. Attacker could initiate transfers from victim accounts.
steps:
1. Capture fund transfer request
2. Replace source account_id with victim's
3. Transfer funds out of victim account

title: View private board contents via board ID
desc: Board API returned full card and member data for private boards when queried with a valid board ID.
steps:
1. Find board ID from any shared link or enumeration
2. GET /1/boards/{id}/cards
3. Read private board contents

title: View any user's transaction history
desc: Transaction history endpoint /api/v2/accounts/{account_id}/transactions lacked ownership verification.
steps:
1. Find target's account ID (sometimes in public profile)
2. GET /api/v2/accounts/{id}/transactions
3. View full transaction history
